resources.string: Makofi plays the music stored on this tablet. No account and no Internet. It can also play to speakers and TVs on your Wi-Fi.
Copy music into the Music folder on this tablet, over USB file transfer or from a computer:
Hidden from the library. The files stay on the tablet.
An offline music player. Plays from the Music folder, on this tablet or on speakers and TVs on the same Wi-Fi.
